description: Cross-judge practice suggestions for NeetCode 150. Each NeetCode 150 problem is tagged with one or more algorithmic pattern tags; each pattern maps to a curated pool of related problems from LeetCode (non-NeetCode-150 entries) and GeeksforGeeks. Related problems intentionally exclude the NeetCode 150 list to avoid self-suggestion.
